stories.title: Flintshire councillor’s motion demands probe into scrapped planning votes
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council will debate a motion on Tuesday calling for an investigation into why roll-call voting was scrapped at Planning Committee, according to papers published ahead of the meeting. stories.title: Public Health Wales sets out plan to catch heart disease risk earlier in Wales

stories.title: More than 20,000 late cancellations hit Welsh patient transport service
